IVX HOLDINGS — FINAL SELF-DEPLOY RECOVERY AND END-TO-END CERTIFICATION TASK

OWNER DIRECTIVE

Implement the real fix now.

Do not run another broad audit.
Do not return another architecture report.
Do not claim VERIFIED until one real IVX engineering task reaches the final state with all required evidence.

CURRENT ROOT CAUSE

The autonomous worker can:

- plan
- inspect
- implement
- run tests
- commit to GitHub

But it fails during deployment because the worker triggers a Render deployment that replaces the same runtime process currently executing the task.

The process dies before it can:

- preserve deployId
- resume the task
- verify the new runtime
- confirm SHA parity
- write final Proof Ledger evidence
- mark the task VERIFIED

This leaves tasks stuck in COMMITTING, DEPLOYING, or QUEUED.

IMPLEMENT PATH B — SELF-DEPLOY HANDOFF AND POST-RESTART RESUME

============================================================
1. PERSIST DEPLOYMENT HANDOFF BEFORE TRIGGERING RENDER
============================================================

Before calling Render, atomically persist:

- taskId
- current status
- next status
- commitSha
- branch
- baseSha
- expectedRuntimeSha
- deploymentRequestedAt
- deploymentAttempt
- deploymentServiceId
- deploymentTriggerRequestId
- preDeployRuntimeSha
- lastSafeCheckpoint
- resumeRequired=true
- resumePhase=LIVE_VERIFYING
- heartbeatAt
- workerId
- proofLedgerId
- ownerApprovalId

Set status:

DEPLOYMENT_REQUESTED

Do not trigger deployment until this transaction succeeds.

============================================================
2. TRIGGER RENDER AND CAPTURE DEPLOY ID
============================================================

Call the Render deployment API.

Immediately store:

- Render Deploy ID
- Render Service ID
- HTTP response
- deployment status
- deployment URL
- trigger timestamp

Then set:

status=DEPLOYING
resumeRequired=true
resumePhase=LIVE_VERIFYING

Do not wait indefinitely inside the process that is about to be replaced.

============================================================
3. EXIT CLEANLY AFTER DEPLOYMENT HANDOFF
============================================================

Once the deployment request and deployId are safely persisted:

- stop active test processes
- flush logs
- flush Proof Ledger events
- release task lock safely
- retain task ownership or use a resumable lease
- mark worker shutdown reason=SELF_DEPLOY_HANDOFF
- exit cleanly

Do not mark FAILED.
Do not mark BLOCKED.
Do not mark VERIFIED.

The task must remain resumable.

============================================================
4. START RESUME SCANNER ON EVERY NEW RUNTIME BOOT
============================================================

On every API/worker startup, automatically run:

recoverSelfDeployTasks()

Search for tasks where:

- resumeRequired=true
- status IN (
  DEPLOYMENT_REQUESTED,
  DEPLOYING,
  LIVE_VERIFYING,
  RETRYING
)
- commitSha is not null
- terminalStatus is null

For every recoverable task:

1. Verify no other worker owns an active lease.
2. Claim the recovery lease atomically.
3. Restore task checkpoint.
4. Poll the stored Render Deploy ID.
5. Continue at LIVE_VERIFYING.

Prevent duplicate recovery by using:

- lease owner
- lease expiration
- idempotency key
- recovery attempt number
- optimistic locking/version column

============================================================
5. VERIFY THE DEPLOYMENT AFTER RESTART
============================================================

The resumed worker must poll Render until exactly one outcome occurs:

SUCCESS:
- deployment status is live
- deployed commit is available

FAILURE:
- deployment failed
- deployment canceled
- deployment timed out

If deployment fails:

- record deployment logs
- set status=ROLLING_BACK
- restore previous known-good deployment
- verify previous runtime SHA
- create incident
- mark FAILED only after rollback evidence exists

============================================================
6. COMPLETE THREE-WAY SHA PARITY
============================================================

After Render reports LIVE, verify:

GitHub Commit SHA
=
Render Deployed Commit SHA
=
Runtime SHA returned by /health

Required calls:

- GitHub branch HEAD
- Render deploy metadata
- GET /health
- GET /health/live
- GET /health/ready
- GET /health/ai
- GET /health/database
- GET /health/queue
- GET /health/provider

Store:

- githubSha
- renderSha
- runtimeSha
- parity result
- timestamps
- response codes
- response bodies or normalized evidence hashes

If parity is false:

- do not mark VERIFIED
- retry within bounded limits
- identify whether propagation delay or wrong deployment occurred
- roll back if mismatch persists

============================================================
7. RUN THE REAL LIVE FEATURE TEST
============================================================

After SHA parity passes, test the exact feature changed by the task.

For the current certification task, test the actual IVX chat/worker route end to end.

Required evidence:

- authenticated request
- taskId
- HTTP status
- expected response
- no 503
- no “Message is required”
- no duplicate task
- no contradictory state
- response timestamp
- traceId
- route test result

A healthy `/health` endpoint alone is not sufficient.

============================================================
8. COMPLETE THE PROOF LEDGER
============================================================

The final Proof Ledger record must include:

- taskId
- original owner request
- root cause
- files inspected
- files changed
- tests executed
- test results
- commitSha
- Render Deploy ID
- Render deployed SHA
- runtimeSha
- SHA parity=true
- live feature verification
- rollback tag
- approval record
- worker restart event
- recovery lease event
- final timestamp
- final status

The existing proofLedgerId may be updated only if append-only history remains preserved.

============================================================
9. SET EXACTLY ONE TERMINAL STATE
============================================================

Mark VERIFIED only when all are present:

- commitSha
- deployId
- runtimeSha
- proofLedgerId
- SHA parity=true
- health checks pass
- live feature test passes
- no active critical incident

Otherwise use exactly one:

FAILED
BLOCKED
CANCELED

Never:

- VERIFIED + BLOCKED
- COMPLETED + FAILED
- VERIFIED without deployId
- VERIFIED without runtimeSha
- VERIFIED based only on tests

============================================================
10. FIX THE QUEUED TASK BEHIND THE STUCK TASK
============================================================

After the current task reaches a terminal state:

- release the single-flight queue lock
- reclaim task 7862343b
- verify it can enter PLANNING
- prevent starvation
- verify queue depth decreases
- verify only one production deployment occurs at a time

Add a regression test proving a self-deploying task does not permanently block later tasks.

============================================================
11. ADD REQUIRED REGRESSION TESTS
============================================================

Add automated tests for:

1. Deployment handoff persisted before Render trigger.
2. Worker exits after deployId persistence.
3. New runtime recovers DEPLOYING task.
4. Duplicate runtime boots do not double-claim.
5. Missing deployId is handled honestly.
6. Render failure triggers rollback.
7. SHA mismatch prevents VERIFIED.
8. Runtime propagation delay retries safely.
9. Live feature failure prevents VERIFIED.
10. Queue lock releases after terminal state.
11. Later queued task resumes.
12. Restart during LIVE_VERIFYING resumes correctly.
13. Proof Ledger contains all four evidence fields.
14. Task has exactly one terminal state.

Run:

- typecheck
- unit tests
- integration tests
- worker recovery tests
- API tests
- deployment-state tests

============================================================
12. DEPLOY THE FIX
============================================================

Complete:

1. Create task branch.
2. Implement self-deploy handoff.
3. Add recovery boot logic.
4. Add leases/idempotency.
5. Add regression tests.
6. Run all tests.
7. Create rollback tag.
8. Commit to owner GitHub.
9. Push branch/main according to approval policy.
10. Trigger Render.
11. Allow the old runtime to exit.
12. Confirm new runtime recovers the task.
13. Complete live verification.
14. Record Proof Ledger.
15. Return final evidence to IVX Chat.

============================================================
13. FINAL CERTIFICATION TEST
============================================================

After the fix is deployed, run one new safe task from IVX Chat with the Rork browser closed.

Required sequence:

IVX Chat
→ HTTP 202 + taskId
→ PLANNING
→ INSPECTING
→ IMPLEMENTING
→ TESTING
→ WAITING_APPROVAL
→ COMMITTING
→ DEPLOYMENT_REQUESTED
→ worker restart
→ recovered by new runtime
→ LIVE_VERIFYING
→ VERIFIED

Required evidence:

- taskId
- branch
- files changed
- tests
- commitSha
- Render Deploy ID
- Render SHA
- runtimeSha
- health results
- live route result
- Proof Ledger ID
- recovery event
- final status
- timestamp

============================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE
============================================================

Do not call IVX IA a fully verified Senior Developer until:

- one task survives its own deployment
- the new runtime resumes it automatically
- GitHub=Render=Runtime
- the live feature passes
- all four evidence fields exist
- Proof Ledger is complete
- the next queued task begins
- Rork is not required during execution

FINAL STATUS MUST BE EXACTLY ONE:

VERIFIED
FAILED
or
BLOCKED

START NOW.

First response must contain only:

1. Files to modify
2. Database fields/migrations required
3. Recovery algorithm
4. Regression tests to add
5. Execution start timestamp
6. Exact owner approval genuinely required

OWNER APPROVAL:

YES — IMPLEMENT PATH B SELF-DEPLOY RECOVERY NOW.
